<details class="daily-panel" open>
<summary>📖 Word of the day &middot; <strong>oxymoron</strong></summary>

<div class="wotd" id="wotd">
<div class="wotd-label">📖 Word of the day</div>
<div class="wotd-word">oxymoron <span class="wotd-pos">noun</span></div>
<div class="wotd-def">An oxymoron is a combination of words that have opposite or very different meanings, such as &quot;cruel kindness&quot; or &quot;open secret.&quot; In broader usage, oxymoron can also refer to something (such as a concept) that is made up of contradictory or incongruous elements.</div>
<div class="wotd-ex">Some of Shakespeare&#x27;s most famous plays are filled with oxymorons such as &quot;loving hate&quot; and &quot;tragical mirth.&quot;</div>
<a class="wotd-src" href="https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/oxymoron-2026-08-18" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Merriam-Webster</a>
</div>

</details>

<div><a href="news/conservation/2026-08-18/#trump-administration-removes-habitat-destruction-from-endangered-species-act-definition-of-harm">Trump Administration Removes Habitat Destruction from Endangered Species Act Definition of &#x27;Harm&#x27;</a>
<p>The Trump administration finalized a rule on July 10, 2026, removing habitat destruction from the regulatory definition of &#x27;harm&#x27; under the Endangered Species Act, effective September 14. The change allows farming, drilling, mining, logging, and development to proceed in endangered species habitats without violating federal law, weakening protections that have been in place for over 50 years.</p>

<div><a href="news/science/2026-08-18/#einsteins-cosmological-constant-explains-accelerating-universe-expansion">Einstein&#x27;s cosmological constant explains accelerating universe expansion</a>
<p>Einstein&#x27;s cosmological constant, abandoned after Hubble&#x27;s discovery of cosmic expansion, was rehabilitated in 1998 when astronomers found the universe&#x27;s expansion is accelerating. The constant now underpins modern cosmological models by explaining this acceleration as a repulsive gravitational influence built into spacetime.</p>
</div>
<div><a href="news/security/2026-08-18/#critical-gitlab-graphql-vulnerability-allows-unauthenticated-project-deletion">Critical GitLab GraphQL Vulnerability Allows Unauthenticated Project Deletion</a>
<p>GitLab patched a critical GraphQL vulnerability (CVE-2026-19478, CVSS 9.4) allowing unauthenticated attackers to delete or modify public projects and user data. A secondary CSRF weakness (CVE-2026-19650, CVSS 7.1) was also fixed; patched versions are 18.11.11, 19.0.8, 19.1.6, and 19.2.4.</p>
</div>

<div><a href="news/science/2026-08-18/#magnetar-observation-provides-possible-evidence-of-quantum-vacuum-birefringence">Magnetar observation provides possible evidence of quantum vacuum birefringence</a>
<p>Observations of magnetar 1E 1547.0-5408 using NASA&#x27;s IXPE and other telescopes have detected the strongest evidence yet of vacuum birefringence, a quantum effect predicted by Heisenberg 90 years ago. The magnetar&#x27;s trillion-fold stronger-than-Earth magnetic field showed X-ray polarization of 40–80% with coherent variations across its 2.1-second rotation.</p>
</div>
<div><a href="news/science/2026-08-18/#hubble-reveals-dwarf-galaxy-merger-in-early-milky-way-history">Hubble Reveals Dwarf Galaxy Merger in Early Milky Way History</a>
<p>NASA&#x27;s Hubble Space Telescope confirmed that the dwarf galaxy &quot;Low-Energy-Kraken-Heracles&quot; merged with the young Milky Way approximately 11.8 billion years ago, pushing back known galactic growth by 1.8 billion years. The discovery, based on analysis of 39 globular clusters, demonstrates the early Milky Way incorporated external galaxies beyond the previously known Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus merger.</p>
</div>
<div><a href="news/science/2026-08-18/#weakening-atlantic-ocean-current-system-could-accelerate-global-warming">Weakening Atlantic Ocean Current System Could Accelerate Global Warming</a>
<p>The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) is weakening faster than climate models predicted, now at its weakest in at least 1,000 years. Two April 2026 studies project 50% weakening by 2100, with risks of abrupt climate disruption including colder European winters, accelerated U.S. East Coast sea-level rise, and displaced African monsoons.</p>
</div>

<div><a href="news/health/2026-08-18/#kratom-poison-center-cases-surge-6500-in-us-over-past-decade">Kratom poison center cases surge 6,500% in US over past decade</a>
<p>Kratom-related poison center cases surged 6,500% from 2010 to 2023, climbing from 19 to 1,242 cases, with severe outcomes rising from zero to 158. The psychoactive plant triggers seizures, heart arrhythmias, liver damage, and respiratory problems, particularly when combined with other drugs.</p>
